title: TeamMatchup
description: One team's next unplayed regular-season game inside the fantasy horizon, under `next_game_v1` (ADR-091), from nflverse's schedule. PUBLISHED CONTEXT ONLY. The sportsbook fields (`total_line`, `team_expected_margin`, the implied points) are a market quantity AGENTS.md section 8 forbids as an intrinsic feature: they are printed beside a player and computed into nothing — no model reads them, no rank, tier or Pick of the Week selection moves with them, and the forbidden-feature guard fails any feature named for them. The upstream sportsbook is not documented by nflverse; no odds prices are published, only the consensus spread and total.

kickoff_utc.description: Scheduled kickoff; always after the build's own timestamp, which is what makes it the NEXT game.

home_away.description: The designation the schedule gives. On a neutral site this is still who the league calls home, and `neutral_site` says the stadium is neither team's.

roof.description: outdoors / open / closed / dome as nflverse publishes it. No temperature or wind: none is published for an unplayed game.

total_line.description: Sportsbook game total. Null until posted, which is about two weeks ahead.

team_expected_margin.description: The spread from THIS team's side: positive means it is favoured by that many points. Re-expressed from nflverse's home-oriented `spread_line` once, at build time, so no consumer handles the upstream sign convention. Null until posted; a null is never a pick'em.

implied_team_points.description: (total_line + team_expected_margin) / 2 — the sportsbook's implied score for this team, not a projection of this product. Null unless both lines are posted.

upcoming_bye_weeks.description: Fantasy-horizon weeks after the cutoff in which this team has no game.

lines_source_id.description: Where the lines were read: nflverse's schedule (`nflreadpy`). Null when no line is posted.

lines_retrieved_at_utc.description: When this build retrieved the schedule the lines came from. nflverse publishes no as-of time of its own for a line, so this is the retrieval time and is labelled as such.
